_instructions: Copy this file to profile.json and fill in your organisation's details. See profile.json for a worked example using a fictional Wellington community trust.

identity.entity_type: registered_organisation (or sole_practitioner / individual — affects org-affiliation scoring)
identity.region: e.g. Wellington City / Lower Hutt / Upper Hutt / Kāpiti / Wairarapa / Wellington Region

demonstrated_impact._instructions: List concrete impact metrics and programmes. These appear in AI-scored summaries and application drafts.
demonstrated_impact.example_metric_1: e.g. 500 people supported annually through community programmes
demonstrated_impact.example_metric_2: e.g. 10 years of continuous service in the Lower Hutt community
programmes: e.g. Weekly community kai (free meals programme)

competencies._instructions: Each competency has a weight (1-10), keywords for matching, and evidence. Higher weight = stronger match priority. Remove or add competency blocks as needed.

example_competency_1.evidence: e.g. Running youth mentoring programme since 2018, 120 young people per year

example_competency_2.evidence: e.g. Weekly community events serving 200+ residents; established community garden

example_competency_3.evidence: e.g. Partnership with local marae; tikanga Māori embedded in all programmes

base_tiers.high_8_10: Direct match with current programmes, demonstrated experience, and stated focus areas
base_tiers.medium_5_7: Adjacent to current work; achievable with partnership or light adaptation
base_tiers.low_1_4: Tangential, requires capabilities not held, or wrong geographic area

notes._instructions: Optional free-text notes that appear in AI prompts. Use these for context that doesn't fit the structured fields above.
notes.example: e.g. We are a small volunteer-led trust; preference for grants under $20k that don't require complex reporting.

funding_keywords: _instructions: Replace with keywords relevant to your focus areas. Used in keyword-based scoring fallback when AI is unavailable.
